about_the_game:
DEMO COMING SOON!

PSYCHO FROGO

Route it. Run it. Beat it.

Psycho Frogo is a fast, addictive “learn the line” speed-runner. Your mission is simple: figure out the best path, then speed run the best path. Every level is a tiny puzzle you can master in seconds—or grind for that perfect, brag-worthy time.

Short levels. Big dopamine. One more try… and another.

What You’ll Do

  • Scout the level, spot the cleanest route.

  • Grab speed powerups, dodge trouble, and charge for the finish.

  • Shave milliseconds, set records, unlock cool skins.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Instant fun: Jump in, restart fast, chase “just one more run.”[]Fair and readable: Everything moves when you move—no cheap hits.

  • Satisfying improvements: See your time drop as your line gets smarter.[]Short & spicy levels: Perfect for quick sessions or long grind nights.

What's included.

  • 13 Levels to Unlock

  • 12 Skins to Unlock

  • Original Music with Music Gallery Unlocks.

  • Steam Achievements aimed to provide 100% satisfaction (This game is made to 100%)
